title: What Does the Cow Say?
statement: The task is to maximize the longest run of consecutive '(' in a regular bracket sequence of length n up to 4·10^5 after at most k operations, each deleting an adjacent "()" and wrapping the string in a new pair. As a tree of matched pairs, a run is a downward path whose left-sibling subtrees are deleted, costing one operation per deleted pair, while each operation prepends one '('.
